name: lottizen
description: Smarter Scratch. Better Odds. — Ontario scratch-ticket value rankings.

scripts.dev: node scripts/prefetch_supabase.mjs && node scripts/gen_data_index.mjs && next dev
scripts.data:scratch: python3 scripts/scrape_olg.py && python3 scripts/calculate_rankings.py && python3 scripts/publish_site_json.py rankings.json
scripts.data:draws: python3 scripts/scrape_draws.py && python3 scripts/calculate_stats.py && python3 scripts/publish_site_json.py draws stats
scripts.data:usa: python3 scripts/scrape_usa.py && python3 scripts/calculate_stats.py && python3 scripts/publish_site_json.py draws stats
